# dsa-conduit: a DSA switch behind its CPU conduit (MediaTek MT798x class).
# eth0 is the conduit (it has a dsa/ directory) and is not a port. lan1-lan3
# are DSA user ports (DEVTYPE=dsa, iflink pointing at the conduit, the
# conduit's MAC, labels in their own of_node); lan1 has no cable: speed -1,
# duplex unknown, operstate lowerlayerdown. eth1 is a second GMAC the board
# uses as WAN (board.json network.wan.device), not bridged and without a link;
# its of_node carries no label. The bridge, a VLAN on it and four wireless
# interfaces (one with a custom name) are noise.
#
# Format: see loadTree in ports_test.go.

-- etc/board.json --
{
	"model": {
		"id": "example,dsa-conduit",
		"name": "Example DSA router"
	},
	"network": {
		"lan": {
			"ports": [
				"lan1",
				"lan2",
				"lan3"
			],
			"protocol": "static"
		},
		"wan": {
			"device": "eth1",
			"protocol": "dhcp"
		}
	},
	"wlan": {
		"phy0": {
			"path": "platform/soc/wifi"
		}
	}
}

-- sys/class/net/br-lan/ --
type=1
ifindex=7
iflink=7
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=4
operstate=up
speed=1000
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:01:04
mtu=1500
uevent=DEVTYPE=bridge\nINTERFACE=br-lan\nIFINDEX=7
bridge/forward_delay=1500
brif/guest
brif/lan1
brif/lan2
brif/lan3
brif/phy0-ap0
brif/phy1-ap0
brif/phy1-ap1
upper_br-lan.1
lower_guest
lower_lan1
lower_lan2
lower_lan3
lower_phy0-ap0
lower_phy1-ap0
lower_phy1-ap1

-- sys/class/net/br-lan.1/ --
type=1
ifindex=8
iflink=7
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=2
operstate=up
speed=1000
duplex=unknown
address=02:00:00:00:01:04
mtu=1500
uevent=DEVTYPE=vlan\nINTERFACE=br-lan.1\nIFINDEX=8
lower_br-lan

-- sys/class/net/eth0/ --
type=1
ifindex=2
iflink=2
flags=0x1003
carrier=1
carrier_changes=1
operstate=up
speed=2500
duplex=full
address=02:00:00:00:01:04
mtu=1504
uevent=OF_NAME=mac\nOF_FULLNAME=/soc/ethernet/mac@0\nOF_COMPATIBLE_0=mediatek,eth-mac\nOF_COMPATIBLE_N=1\nINTERFACE=eth0\nIFINDEX=2
dsa/tagging=mtk
upper_lan1
upper_lan2
upper_lan3
of_node/compatible=mediatek,eth-mac\0
device/uevent=DRIVER=mtk_soc_eth\nOF_NAME=ethernet
device/of_node/compatible=mediatek,eth\0
device/driver -> ../../../bus/platform/drivers/mtk_soc_eth
